title: Signed integer division
spec: Implement divide(n, d) for arbitrary-size signed integer n and positive integer d. Return the quotient truncated toward zero. Do not use floating point conversion.
target_defect: Floor division rounds negative non-integral quotients away from zero.
author_rationale: The change keeps quotient calculation entirely in integer arithmetic.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
